rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.talk.light: Let there be light. Small charge, big ego.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.talk.dig: Excavated. Try not to bury yourself again.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.talk.dig_non: Nothing's pinning you that I can move.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.talk.dig_none: Nothing soft enough to dig. Or nothing there.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.talk.recipe_: I don't know how to make "%s", sorry.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.talk.recipe_no: "%s" isn't a thing I can find a recipe for.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.talk.unknown: I didn't catch that. Try "light up", "report" or "fly me to the village".
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.talk.unknown: I don't do that. I do light, digging, reports, scans, recipes and flying.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.talk.no_char: Not enough charge for that, sorry.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.talk.no_charge: No charge. I'm a suit, not a miracle.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.pilot.go: Setting course for the %s, %s blocks. Sit back.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.pilot.go: %s, %s blocks out. Try not to touch anything.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.pilot.airbor: Get us into full flight first, then I'll take us.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.pilot.airborne: I fly. You get us airborne. That's the deal.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.pilot.unknow: I don't know where "%s" is. The village, or home?
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.pilot.unknown: "%s" isn't on my map. Village or home.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.pilot.none: I can't find one near enough, sorry.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.pilot.none: Nothing like that within range. Shocking.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.pilot.empty: Out of charge, I'm handing you the controls!
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.evac: The suit's breaking up, I'm getting you out!
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.evac: Plates gone, charge gone. Ejecting the passenger.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.downed: Lie still. I'll do the shooting.
